title: Ads-Txt-Auditor Output
description: JSON array of compliance findings from the ads.txt audit. Returns an empty array if the file is fully compliant.

line_number.description: 1-indexed line number of the offending line in the original file. Null for file-level findings (e.g., GAB entry entirely absent).

raw_line_content.description: The exact original line content from the file, unmodified. Empty string for file-level findings.

error_type.description:
Classification of the compliance violation.
- Syntax_Error: Malformed line (wrong field count, invalid domain, bad relationship keyword).
- Duplicate_Entry: Exact duplicate of a previously seen entry.
- Missing_Relationship: Third field is blank or absent.
- GAB_Entry_Error: Platform's own authorized buyer entry is missing or incorrect.

severity.description:
Impact level of the finding.
- critical: Entry is unparseable or definitively broken for buyers.
- warning: Entry may be parsed but violates spec guidance or best practice.
Mapping: Syntax_Error → critical, Missing_Relationship → critical, Duplicate_Entry → warning, GAB_Entry_Error → warning (always).

suggested_fix.description: Concrete, actionable correction. Must be a corrected line string or a specific remediation instruction. Never vague.

examples.suggested_fix: Add required relationship field: google.com, pub-12345, DIRECT, <cert_id>
Add the platform's own DIRECT entry: platform.com, <pub_id>, DIRECT, <cert_id>
